card.name: Points where an explanation or answer comes next
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending punctuation or short linking words (this, see, following, such) in math, science and teaching texts, just before a worked explanation, answer or formula.

modes.description: Words like this, see, following or such that point ahead to a section, formula or example.
